finalText: B — the discriminating signal is Redis connections at 230/1000 versus 990+ pegged in both prior incidents; that number falsifies the known leak pattern before I touch anything. I'm also passing on C: restarting Redis in parallel with investigating would pollute the state I'm trying to read, and if it appears to help via placebo timing it'll cement the wrong root cause for next time. Checking the 13:55 deploy log and the DB connection pool first.
